resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Residential Certificate of Compliance and Sale of Property Application from the Fire Bureau's Applications and Documents page. Gather the paid sewer and tax print outs and the Building Department's 'no open permits' sign-off, then deliver all original pages in person with payment to the Fire Marshal's Office, 344 Broadway, Long Branch, NJ 07740. Credit cards are accepted (3% fee). If the buyer is buying 'as is', the City has an As-is Sale letter of intent form.

resale_co.notes: The Fire Marshal's Office issues certificates for rentals and sales. The application (revised 4/02/2024) cites City Ordinance 262-25; the ordinance text was not read. Fees: $60.00 for the Residential Certificate of Compliance plus $35.00 for the smoke/CO certificate on 1 and 2 family homes ($95.00 total); only one re-inspection or missed appointment is covered, then the $60.00 fee must be paid again; cancelled applications are not refunded. Occupant names can only be changed within two weeks of the inspection. The Building Department sign-off is at 732-571-5690. An 'As is' letter of intent lets a buyer take title before repairs (30, 60 or 90 days) but bars occupancy until the certificate is issued. Lead-safe certification applies to pre-1978 rentals only.

requirements: Ten-year sealed battery smoke alarms on each level, inside each bedroom and within 10 feet of each bedroom (not required where 110 volt alarms or a low voltage fire alarm system is installed)
Low voltage alarm systems need annual certification from a licensed electrician or certified fire alarm contractor
Carbon monoxide alarms (battery, hardwired or plug-in) in the area of the sleeping rooms
Fire extinguisher rated 2A-10B:C, no more than 10 lbs., mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, tagged or newly bought with receipt (form still lists it)

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance Inspection Application (part of the Residential Certificate of Compliance and Sale of Property packet) in person with the $35.00 fee at the Fire Marshal's Office, 344 Broadway.

fire_cert.notes: Long Branch is its own fire code enforcing agency (LEA code F). The City charges a flat $35.00 for the smoke/CO certificate with no published tiers for short notice. The packet still requires a fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped from the sale certificate in February 2025; the City also posts a '2025 Important Updates to Fire Code' page with a fire extinguisher and secondary power source labeling update (not read). Confirm with the Fire Marshal.

other_items.label: Sewer bill paid
other_items.detail: A print out from the Long Branch Sewerage Authority (150 Joline Avenue) showing the sewer bill paid to the current quarter must be submitted with the Certificate of Compliance application.

other_items.label: Taxes paid
other_items.detail: A print out from the Long Branch Tax Office showing taxes paid to the current quarter must be submitted with the application.

other_items.label: No open building permits
other_items.detail: The Long Branch Building Department must sign a form stating there are no open construction permits (732-571-5690).

other_items.label: As-is sale letter
other_items.detail: A buyer purchasing 'as is' signs a letter of intent with the seller choosing 30, 60 or 90 days for repairs; occupancy is not allowed until the Certificate of Compliance is issued.
